findings.text: non-blocking: content_from_prompt_context derives source_text only from item['dd_description'] (line 865) and enclosing_structure_text only from context 'anc' / dd_context.ancestors / item.enclosing|ancestors (lines 858-863); the name_composition call sites pass the compose batch item (worker_compose_batches.py:351, worker_compose_and_validate.py:311), whose enriched shape carries 'documentation' and 'ancestor_context' (worker_extraction_and_enrichment.py:789 _enrich_batch_items) but neither dd_description nor those enclosing keys. Every live name_composition receipt therefore records source_text and enclosing_structure_text absent even when the batch prompt carried them, disagreeing with the census for the same names.

non-blocking: STAGE_TEMPLATES names one fixed template pair per stage, but two production stages choose a variant the census never renders: worker_review_docs.py:443-445 sends review_docs_parent_* for a parent and appends _conventions, and worker_compose_and_validate.py:300-305 sends generate_name_dd_names for a names-mode batch. The census's scoring_review digest for a parent name and its name_composition digest for a names-mode batch are therefore not the prompt those stages send.

non-blocking: no test exercises any of the eight production call sites; the tests drive receipt_for_stage/record_stage_receipt directly, so deleting a record_stage_receipt call from a worker_tasks stage would leave the suite green and the live half silently inert for that stage.

non-blocking: _CHILDREN_QUERY still duplicates the live-children loader at worker_tasks/worker_review_docs.py:174 (same HAS_PARENT match and name_stage exclusion); the worker's manifest records the decline with the semantic differences (origin filter, placeholder-to-null mapping, 12-child truncation, kind projection) as the reason.

justifications.evidence: the committed docs/evidence/fragments/sn-case-file-generation/context-receipts-gate.txt is byte-identical to the run log gate-full.log (REVISION=0674dc6b5, 8912 passed, EXIT=0) and the census self-check records 251 names and 12 omissions, though the gate predates the delivered head 71381a38a by one docs-only commit and the manifest carries no baseline/after suite pair.
justifications.fit: context_receipt.py follows the surrounding worker_tasks idiom of function-local imports (worker_compose_batches.py:351) and registers its two copied-list touches in tests/standard_names/test_source_reads.py:468-469, with no plan or ticket identifiers in names or comments.
